 About The Role
 We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of our Snowflake and dbt-based data pipelines. You will be responsible for implementing robust ELT solutions that efficiently transform data and provide valuable insights to the organization.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain high-performance ELT data pipelines using Snowflake and dbt
Model data at both conceptual and technical levels based on business requirements
Optimize SQL queries and dbt models to ensure optimal performance
Implement and maintain DataOps infrastructure for deployment automation
Configure and manage data security (RBAC, Row-Level Security, Dynamic Data Masking)
Ensure efficient data ingestion from AWS S3 to Snowflake
Orchestrate data flows through dbt and create DAGs with proper tag management
Implement data quality testing via dbt tests
Manage administrative aspects of Snowflake databases
 Required Technical Skills
Snowflake 
Mastery of advanced Snowflake features (Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning)
Configuration and optimization of Snowflake warehouses
Management of external stages and Snowpipe for ingestion from AWS S3
Configuration and implementation of RBAC, RLS, and Dynamic Data Masking security mechanisms
Snowflake database administration (object creation/management, monitoring, optimization)
dbt (data build tool) 
Advanced SQL model development in dbt
Creation and optimization of data models (dimensions, facts, etc.)
Use of Jinja macros to create dynamic and reusable SQL code
Configuration of dbt tests for data validation
Implementation of dbt snapshots for change tracking
Creation of optimized DAGs with proper tag and dependency management
Data model documentation
DataOps & Automation 
Use of schemachange for schema migration automation
Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) for data pipelines
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
AWS & Integration 
Knowledge of AWS S3 and its integration with Snowflake
Configuration of external stages and ingestion processes
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Snowflake Tasks and Dynamic Tables
Knowledge of data mesh and data governance principles
Familiarity with data testing frameworks
Experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences industry
 Certifications (Preferred)
SnowPro Core Certification - highly valued
dbt Analytics Engineering Certification - a plus
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, or similar) - a plus
 Soft Skills
Excellent problem-solving skills and analytical mindset
Rigor and attention to detail
Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively
Adaptability to an evolving technical environment
 Experience And Education
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in data engineering
Significant experience with Snowflake and dbt
Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or similar field
